scope: Retain and same-version replay of TABLESTYLE CMC method 0xC8 without assigning it color semantics.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: The specification describes the R2004+ CMC BS/BL/RC slots but does not define method 0xC8 semantics. The implementation treats the packed BL as opaque.

physical_observation.provenance: ODA-converted scratch DWG; not added to the repository
physical_observation.limit: This converted source is a parser/wire observation, not a native producer or rendering witness. The exploratory selected whole-file output did not audit the source TABLESTYLE reactor and extension-dictionary closure and is not counted as graph/output qualification.

implementation.reader: TABLESTYLE CMC readers retain the packed 32-bit word for method 0xC8 in legacy rows and R24 cell-style/content records.
implementation.model: The existing m_rgb slot stores the low 24 opaque bits only when m_method is 0xC8. No public struct data members were added, so DRW_TableStyleCmcColor layout is unchanged.
implementation.writer: AC1018+ TABLESTYLE output emits the retained packed word, flags, reserved index, and optional names after strict consistency checks. Missing/mismatched payloads and pre-AC1018 output are refused.
implementation.dxf: DXF continues using the established no-color sentinel for C8 and suppresses group 420 so opaque low bits are never emitted as RGB.

claimBoundary: No meaning is assigned to method 0xC8 or its low 24 bits.
No native rendering, broader producer, strict source graph, or support claim is promoted.
No DWG/DXF fixture file was added.
